slides.texte_overlay:
Things a man stops doing
when he finally grows up

1. He stops needing
the last word

He lets it go. Peace is worth more.

2. He stops chasing approval

He does it right,
not to be watched.

3. He stops fearing
the beginner stage

New sport, new subject.
He starts at zero, happily.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. He stops fearing
the beginner stage

New subject on the Sophia app,
new sport. He starts at zero.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. He stops talking down
on other men

Their win doesn't threaten him.

5. He stops sulking at feedback

"Fair point. I'll fix it."

6. He stops over-explaining
his no

One sentence. Done.
